sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे ।नाविकानाह्वयामास लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।। ७.४६.३२ ॥
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā pramṛjya nayane śubhe ।nāvikānāhvayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।। 7.46.32 ॥

translations.english: Having heard her words and wiped his beautiful eyes, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, called the boatmen.
